title: Session namespace and handoff
description: Sessions (channels) live in a hierarchical path namespace. A bot connects the user to another session with connect_user(path); the client switches and voice follows. A lazy context-block mechanism renders a session directory into each model call. Design: docs/SESSION_NAMESPACE.md. Definition of Done: all child stories closed, behavior specified in features/.
right_now_summary: The team is defining session handoffs, hierarchical paths, and fresh context rendering while refining directory limits.
